findings.issue: הַנִּדָּה is a common noun (H5079), not a name; «nidá» leaves the lemma untranslated instead of Spanish.
Qal imperfect 3ms is a stative/inchoative «be/become unclean»; «se impurecerá» is pronominal smoothing and does not change the participant.

notes: Remaining clauses match the tokens in person, number, and participants.
